description: This file defines the Predicate class, representing various predicate expressions used in Spark SQL's connector expressions filtering system. It includes documentation on supported predicate types and their SQL semantics.

classes.name: Predicate
classes.description: Represents predicate expressions with various SQL semantic operations, supporting type safety through subclasses like And, Or, Not, etc.

methods.name: Predicate
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a Predicate with a name and child expressions; asserts that 'BOOLEAN_EXPRESSION' has exactly one child.
